description: This file defines a report for comparing stock and account values in ERPNext, including data retrieval and report column definitions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, returning columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes stock ledger and GL data, returning a list of discrepancies.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_data
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries based on filters and account information.

methods.name: get_gl_data
methods.description: Retrieves general ledger entries and aggregates account values.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report display.
